inlines.v: INCUM'BENCY, noun [from incumbent.] A lying or resting on something. 1. The state of holding or being in possession of a benefice, or of an office. These fines are to be paid to the bishop, only during his incumbency There is no test of the tenure, but incumbency on the part of the king.
